    External MCP Server Catalog¶

    Beyond CorpusIQ's 40+ built-in connectors, the MCP ecosystem now has 22,000+ servers spanning every domain. This catalog tracks the most relevant third-party MCP servers for business operators - curated from mcp.so and mcpservers.org.

    Last updated: November 19, 2026 (evening) · Latest pass: a six-hour window in which the directory moved for the first time in three passes and carried all three finds itself. The twelve numbered server maps returned 66,962 raw <loc> entries against 66,677 at the 18:10Z midday-supplement capture, the entire rise of 285 inside servers/12 (958 to 1,243) with every other map identical to the entry and the twelve counts summing exactly (7,588 / 5,949 / 6,518 / 6,746 / 6,954 / 6,756 / 9,351 / 6,590 / 4,022 / 2,608 / 2,637 / 1,243); the distinct twelve-map key set read 22,952 against 22,717 and the union 22,986 against 22,752, and the 251 keys stamped in servers/12 at or after the cutoff decompose into a 45-slug cotlet-dev integration fleet, 5 Apify actors, prior dispositions re-entering under a domain slug, and a tail of consumer and utility listings - with three genuine products inside it and none in the feed or the queue. The mcp.so feed answered 200 at 158,554 bytes with 30 stamps, 26 derived cards and six above the cutoff (node-mantis 02:44Z, caoliao-qr-code 02:26Z, vakaymood 00:43Z, aisma and asin402-amazon-data 19:56Z, senpi-ai-quant 19:17Z), all six held on carried classes. The submission queue carried #7668 to #7685, seventeen arrivals with bodies in one authenticated call, all seventeen held with the class or gate named. 3 servers catalogued and 3 guides: FigureDeck, keyless on all three tools at https://mcp.figuredeck.com/mcp, where the 2026 conforming limit for Los Angeles County is $1,249,125, exactly 1.5 times the $832,750 baseline, two Hawaii counties sit at $1,299,500 above that ceiling, and a $450,000 loan at 6.5 percent reproduces to the cent at $2,844.31 a month; Reevi, keyless on one tool at https://reevi.ai/mcp, which returned 12 graded buyers across the US and Germany in 23.1 seconds against a pool of 2,388 importers, with a report link that answers 200 without a sign-in and five free searches a day; and Raising.fi at the documented tier, where an anonymous initialize answers 401 with a complete challenge naming one scope and the issuer's RFC 8414 document offers dynamic registration and PKCE S256 in front of a five-tool read surface.     🆕 November 19, 2026 - Evening Sweep (3 New, 3 Guides)¶

The boundary is stated by the server, not hidden: contacts and introductions live on reevi.ai behind a free account, the introductions are human-approved and sent by e-mail or WhatsApp, and the free counter decremented from 5 to 4 inside the response.     • Optimatika MCP - Proven-Optimal Optimisation Solver - remote Streamable HTTP at https://service-api.optimatika.se/optimisation/mcp, optimatika-optimisation-service build a74468c on protocol 2025-06-18, three tools (solve, translate, environment), no auth of any kind, registry se.optimatika/optimisation-service, queue entry #7654 filed 2026-11-19T10:52:09Z. The catalog's first operations-research solver, and the class had no owner: linear program, operations research and integer programming returned zero hits across the index and every sweep ledger, so this is a new slice rather than a fifth opinion on an existing one. Every answer reproduces by hand: maximising 3x + 2y under x + y <= 4, x <= 2, y <= 3 returned state: OPTIMAL, objective 10.0, x = 2.0, y = 2.0; a production mix maximising 40A + 30B under 2A + B <= 100 labour and A + 2B <= 80 machine hours returned 2,200 at A = 40, B = 20 with labour at 100 of 100 and machine at 80 of 80, both resources exhausted; a minimisation of 12x + 8y returned 44 at x = 1, y = 4 where the naive corner costs 48 and the other two corners cost 60 and 48; and an integer model with both variables declared General returned whole numbers, desks = 2, chairs = 3, for 22 rather than a relaxed fractional answer. The refusal is a first-class result: a model whose constraints contradict returned state: INFEASIBLE, optimal: false, with the note no solution satisfies all the constraints: the model is infeasible - or, occasionally, unbounded, which is the vendor naming the one ambiguity a solver status cannot resolve on its own. The limits are asked rather than discovered: environment reports a Polar shared instance with no licence key, ojAlgo solvers only and nativeSolvers: false, a ceiling of 1,000 variables or constraints, a 30-second suffice after which a result returns FEASIBLE unless it is proven optimal, and a 60-second abort. One gap recorded: translate was driven only to its refusal ('from' and 'to' are required, each LP, MPS or EBM), so a successful round trip is unverified, and solve was exercised on LP and MILP but not on the QP and MIQP the server offers.
    • Visamundi MCP - Visa and Entry Rules by Nationality - remote Streamable HTTP at https://mcp.visamundi.io/, visamundi-public-mcp 2.0.0 on protocol 2025-06-18, eight tools of which five are keyless reference reads and three open an application, registry io.visamundi/visa, server code at github.com/Visamundi/visamundi-mcp, queue entry #7658 filed 2026-11-19T12:05:41Z. The catalog's first global visa matrix. CheckChinaTransit answers one country's visa-free transit rule precisely; this answers nationality by destination as a table and adds the health and customs rows that belong to the same decision. The rules are typed, which is why it integrates: get_vaccines on Kenya returned eight entries where yellow fever is needed, not recommended, with certificate required for travellers aged 1 year and over arriving from a country with risk of transmission - a rule conditioned on where the traveller came from - while malaria is recommended with the altitude and central-Nairobi carve-outs and the instruction to take preventive medicine. Priced, not described: list_visas on Vietnam returned a single-entry e-Visa at 25 USD for 90 days stay and validity, a multiple-entry at 50 USD whose own description carries the exception that a stay under 45 days needs no visa at all, and a Pre-Arrival declaration at no government fee; get_visa on product 13083 added passport_validity_months: 1 and the two mandatory documents. Customs by destination: Japan returned three bottles of about 760 ml at age 20 and over, 200 cigarettes against a heated-tobacco and 250 g alternative, and a JPY 1,000,000 declaration threshold, with the medicines field returned as an empty string. Two defects recorded rather than smoothed: get_vaccines and get_customs reject the argument destination that both their descriptions and the server's own instructions name, requiring country_code and failing with input validation error; and an invalid country code returns HTTP 200 with success: true beside code: country_not_found, so any caller checking the status flag reads a failure as a success. The requirement field has no unit: FR into CN returned 30, CA into MX returned 180, and other pairs returned the named statuses visa required and e-visa, so the value is either days permitted without a visa or a status and the response does not distinguish them.

    • htsapi.dev MCP - US Tariff Classification Sources - remote Streamable HTTP, stateless, no session id issued, at https://htsapi.dev/mcp, htsapi 1.0.0 on protocol 2025-06-18, eight tools of which seven are keyless and were driven across eleven tools/call requests; registry dev.htsapi/mcp 1.0.0 published 2026-11-19T07:10:50Z, queue entry #7637 filed 07:11:28Z. This is the other half of Tariff Monitor rather than a duplicate of it: that entry prices the stack on ten-digit lines, this one serves the schedule one level at a time with the notes that decide between headings, the CBP rulings corpus with each ruling's status, and what importers actually paid. The schedule is read, not guessed: lookup_hts_code with no argument returned all 22 sections and their chapters in 18,207 characters, and on 6404 it returned 129 lines under three subheadings (41 / 79 / 9) with the newest rulings under the heading. The notes are the argument: get_notes returned chapter 64's exclusions verbatim, note 3's definition of rubber and plastics, note 4's rule that the material with the greatest external surface area decides the upper, and the subheading note that limits sports footwear to designated athletic categories. Precedent works in both directions: search_rulings on led camping lantern returned three rulings by meaning with the top hit at 0.736 similarity, code 8513.10.4000, status: current, each carrying the product description CBP examined; rulings_under_code on 6403.99 counted 719 current rulings against 1 whose goods moved away. The paid rate is the number nobody models: importers_paid on 6404.11.20 from CN returned a general duty of 10.5 percent beside 29.8 percent in 2026-07, 33.0 in 2026-08 and 34.7 in 2026-09, the difference being Chapter 99 duties the response names and anti-dumping and countervailing duties it states are excluded. Four limits recorded rather than smoothed: Chapter 99 lines are refused by lookup_hts_code with a pointer to importers_paid; an eight-digit code in importers_paid falls back to the HS6 group with rate_pct: null and the numbers in months; a heading carries no single rate (general_duty: null against aggregated subheading strings such as 10.5% / 7.5% / 37.5% / 48% / ...); and classify_product refuses cleanly at one credit. The legal posture is stated by the vendor and worth keeping: CBP has ruled that an unlicensed platform suggesting codes beyond six digits for goods to be entered is conducting customs business, an importer may classify its own goods, and the free tools serve the sources while the paid classifier is labelled guidance rather than a binding ruling. Price: 50 calls a day per IP and 10 a minute keyless, $9 a month for unlimited read tools under fair use, and classification credits at 100 for $10 or 1,000 for $50. Freshness is published at /v1/status: USITC schedule synced 2026-11-16T02:02:45Z, CBP CROSS 2026-11-17T04:33:16Z with a newest ruling dated 2026-10-30, Chapter 99 2026-11-16T02:03:13Z, none stale.

    Data Firewall Suite (PortEden)¶

    The PortEden Secure* family puts a data firewall between AI agents and your Google/Microsoft accounts. Every action is permission-gated, content-redacted, and audit-logged. One-click revoke. Complementary to CorpusIQ's read-only external-source retrieval model.

    Secure Calendar (Google Calendar & Outlook)¶

    Search schedule, check availability, create/reschedule/cancel events, RSVP. AI held to permissions you grant. Every change logged.

    Secure Email (Gmail & Outlook)¶

    Search, read, send, reply, forward, label, delete email. Sensitive content redacted before AI sees it. Full audit trail.

    Secure Google Drive¶

    Search, read, create, copy, rename, move, share, delete files and folders. Sensitive data redacted. Permission-gated.

    Secure Google Docs¶

    Search, read, create, copy, rename, precisely edit documents (insert, append, replace). Every edit logged.

    Secure Google Sheets¶

    Create/copy spreadsheets, read tabs/ranges, write/append values, manage tabs. Protects sensitive values, audits every write.

    Secure Google Sheets MCP Server ★ New¶

    Dedicated MCP server for PortEden's Google Sheets data firewall. Read, write, and manage spreadsheet data with permission gating and audit logging. Separate from the Drive-level Secure Google Drive server.

    Governed, shared, self-improving memory for AI agent fleets - built for multi-tenant, multi-agent production environments. Apache 2.0. 131 GitHub stars. Production-proven: eToro runs 300+ agents on Memclaw (26,500+ memories, 1,372 shared skills, 23ms p50 search). Features: tenant isolation, visibility scopes (agent/team/org), agent trust tiers (0-3), full audit trails, single-pass LLM enrichment (14 memory types), hybrid search (pgvector + full-text + knowledge graph), contradiction detection, and PII auto-flagging. Managed platform at memclaw.net or self-hosted via Docker. pip install memclaw-client or npm install @caura/memclaw-client. Essential for operators running fleets of AI agents who need governed, shared memory with production-grade isolation and audit.

    Memory Engine ★ New (June 29)¶

    Atomic memory model for AI agents - knowledge stored as atoms (facts, decisions, events, preferences, logs, procedures, notes, session messages). Multi-factor ranking combines FTS relevance × confidence × recency × weight (not just BM25). Organic decay and reinforcement over time. Essential for operators building AI agents that need sophisticated, long-term memory with context-aware recall beyond simple vector search. github.com/SimoneB79/memory-engine

    memo ★ New (July 1)¶

    100% local persistent semantic memory for AI agents on Apple Silicon (MLX) or Linux/Ubuntu (CPU). Markdown source of truth, sqlite-vec + BM25 hybrid search, codegraph-backed knowledge graph. MCP server + CLI. No cloud, no API keys. Privacy-first memory infrastructure for operators who need local-only AI agent memory without cloud dependencies. Essential for regulated industries (HIPAA, GDPR) or operators who refuse cloud-based memory infrastructure. github.com/jagoff/memo · pip install mlx-memo

    SPM - Structured Project Memory ★ New (July 2)¶

    Project-scoped memory for AI agents with provenance tracking and access control. Delivered as a remote MCP connector - context packs, verification, context graphs, and cryptographic memory integrity. Essential for operators running multi-agent workflows who need auditable, verifiable project memory with governance. github.com/getspm/spm-agent-connectors · Integration Guide

    How to Use External MCP Servers¶

    Most MCP clients (Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf, Hermes) support multiple MCP server connections simultaneously. To add an external server alongside CorpusIQ:

    {
 "mcpServers": {
 "corpusiq": {
 "url": "https://mcp2.corpusiq.io/mcp",
 "transport": "streamable-http"
 },
 "firecrawl": {
 "command": "npx",
 "args": ["-y", "firecrawl-mcp"],
 "env": {
 "FIRECRAWL_API_KEY": "fc-YOUR_KEY"
 }
 },
 "playwright": {
 "command": "npx",
 "args": ["@playwright/mcp@latest"]
 }
 }
}

    Check each server's documentation for specific transport type (streamable HTTP, stdio, SSE) and authentication requirements.
